method.source: Reference lists come from Crossref open metadata
method.seed: papers with full text in the assistant's search index, found in Crossref by DOI or by near-identical title (similarity >= 0.9)
method.ref: works in a seed's reference list (with or without DOI; without DOI they are matched by title and year)
method.root: works cited by >= 3 of the DOI references that >= 2 seeds share (common intellectual roots)
method.cluster: TF-IDF of each title plus the titles of the works citing it (abstract or first pages for indexed papers), SVD, then k-means; k = 12 chosen by silhouette (0.107, i.e. topics overlap)
method.layout: force layout on the citation graph with a weak pull to each cluster centre
method.caveat: Only 222 of 438 indexed papers have an open reference list (NASA reports and some publishers deposit none), so a missing link means not catalogued, not not cited
